title: PostgreSQL Full-Stack Developer
description: Progress from no relational-database experience to professional PostgreSQL application development, covering SQL, relational design, performance, security, application integration, and production fundamentals for a full-stack developer.

nodes.label: Relational Database Foundations
nodes.description: Understand what a database and DBMS are, learn the relational vocabulary of databases, schemas, tables, rows, and columns, and translate simple application concepts like users, posts, and comments into relational entities.

nodes.label: SQL Query Fundamentals
nodes.description: Write SELECT queries with filtering, sorting, limiting, and DISTINCT, then perform INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE operations safely, including PostgreSQL's RETURNING clause, to implement complete CRUD operations.

nodes.label: Tables, Schemas & Data Types
nodes.description: Create and alter tables with CREATE TABLE and ALTER TABLE, organize objects with schemas, and choose appropriate PostgreSQL data types — numeric, text, boolean, date/time, identifiers, and structured types like JSONB and arrays — based on application requirements.

nodes.label: Keys & Constraints
nodes.description: Define primary keys, composite keys, and foreign keys with appropriate referential actions, and apply NOT NULL, UNIQUE, and CHECK constraints so the database makes invalid application state difficult to persist.

nodes.label: Relationships & Joins
